SELECT T6.TARGET_NAME assetType10Str, T1.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, T1.ENTRUST_STATUS entrustStatus, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, T2.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, T3.ASSET_TYPE1 assetType1, T3.ASSET_TYPE_10 assetType10, T3.ASSET_TYPE_11 assetType11, T3.BUSI_PS ps, T3.TERM_DAYS termDays, T3.EXERCISE_TYPE exerciseType, T1.VDATE vdate, T1.MDATE mdate, T1.INV_MANAGER_ID invManagerId, T1.ENTRUST_NUM entrustNum, T1.REMARK remark FROM ETR_ENTRUST T1 inner join PTL_PORTFOLIO T2 on T2.PORTFOLIO_ID = T1.PORTFOLIO_ID inner join ETR_ENTRUST_ADD T3 on T3.ENTRUST_ID = T1.ENTRUST_ID inner join PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY T5 on T2.PORTFOLIO_ID=T5.PORTFOLIO_ID and T5.USER_ID= #{loginUser} inner join OPT_TARGET_INFO T6 on T3.ASSET_TYPE_10 = T6.TARGET_ID
AND ((T2.PORTFOLIO_ID IN
null) OR T2.PORTFOLIO_ID IN in (
#{prot} ) or (T2.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID IN
null) OR T2.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID in (
#{prot} ) )
AND T3.ASSET_TYPE_11 in
#{item}
AND T3.ASSET_TYPE_10 in
#{item}
AND T3.BUSI_PS =#{ps}
AND T3.EXERCISE_TYPE =#{exerciseType}
AND T1.ENTRUST_STATUS in
#{item}
AND T1.VDATE >= STR_TO_DATE(#{startDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND T1.MDATE <=STR_TO_DATE(#{endDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND T3.ASSET_TYPE in(#{option})
ORDER BY T1.ENTRUST_ID DESC
